implementation.starterCode:
# SQLAlchemy でユーザーモデルを定義してください
# Note: 学習環境では実際のDBは使用しませんが、コードは学べます

# ここにコードを書いてください
implementation.solution:
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, DateTime, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from datetime import datetime

# Baseクラスを作成
Base = declarative_base()

# Userモデル
class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    username = Column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = Column(String(100), unique=True, nullable=False)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<User(id={self.id}, username='{self.username}', email='{self.email}')>"

# Productモデル
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'products'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(500))
    price = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    stock = Column(Integer, default=0)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<Product(id={self.id}, name='{self.name}', price={self.price})>"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("SQLAlchemy Models defined!\n")
    print("📋 User Model:")
    print("  - id (Primary Key)")
    print("  - username (Unique, Not Null)")
    print("  - email (Unique, Not Null)")
    print("  - is_active (Boolean)")
    print("  - created_at (DateTime)")
    print("\n📋 Product Model:")
    print("  - id (Primary Key)")
    print("  - name (Not Null)")
    print("  - description")
    print("  - price (Not Null)")
    print("  - stock (Integer)")
    print("  - created_at (DateTime)")
    print("\n📝 Note: これらのクラスがDBテーブルにマッピングされます")

implementation.starterCode:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
# (モデル定義は省略)

# CRUDスター操作を実装してください
# - ユーザーの作成
# - ユーザーの検索
# - ユーザーの更新
# - ユーザーの削除
# ここにコードを書いてください
implementation.solution:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from typing import List, Optional

# 簡易モデル（実際は別ファイルから import）
class User:
    def __init__(self, id, username, email):
        self.id = id
        self.username = username
        self.email = email
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<User(id={self.id}, username='{self.username}')>"

# インメモリデータベース（シミュレーション）
users_db = {}
next_id = 1

class UserRepository:
    """User CRUD operations"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def create(username: str, email: str) -> User:
        """CREATE: 新規ユーザー作成"""
        global next_id
        user = User(id=next_id, username=username, email=email)
        users_db[next_id] = user
        next_id += 1
        print(f"✅ Created: {user}")
        return user
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:
        """READ: IDでユーザー取得"""
        user = users_db.get(user_id)
        if user:
            print(f"📖 Found: {user}")
        else:
            print(f"❌ User ID {user_id} not found")
        return user
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_all() -> List[User]:
        """READ: 全ユーザー取得"""
        users = list(users_db.values())
        print(f"📋 Found {len(users)} users")
        return users
    
    @staticmethod
    def update(user_id: int, username: str = None, email: str = None) -> Optional[User]:
        """UPDATE: ユーザー情報更新"""
        user = users_db.get(user_id)
        if not user:
            print(f"❌ User ID {user_id} not found")
            return None
        
        if username:
            user.username = username
        if email:
            user.email = email
        
        print(f"✏️  Updated: {user}")
        return user
    
    @staticmethod
    def delete(user_id: int) -> bool:
        """DELETE: ユーザー削除"""
        if user_id in users_db:
            user = users_db.pop(user_id)
            print(f"🗑️  Deleted: {user}")
            return True
        print(f"❌ User ID {user_id} not found")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== CRUD Operations Demo ===\n")
    
    # CREATE
    print("1️⃣  CREATE Operations:")
    user1 = UserRepository.create("alice", "alice@example.com")
    user2 = UserRepository.create("bob", "bob@example.com")
    user3 = UserRepository.create("charlie", "charlie@example.com")
    
    # READ
    print("\n2️⃣  READ Operations:")
    UserRepository.get_by_id(1)
    UserRepository.get_all()
    
    # UPDATE
    print("\n3️⃣  UPDATE Operations:")
    UserRepository.update(1, username="alice_updated")
    
    # DELETE
    print("\n4️⃣  DELETE Operations:")
    UserRepository.delete(2)
    UserRepository.get_all()
    
    print("\n📝 Note: 実際はSQLAlchemyのsession.add(), session.commit()を使用")
keyPoints: セッション管理が重要
commitしないと反映されない
トランザクションで整合性
例外処理でロールバック
